calibrated_calibration_transfer_report.claim_boundary: Offline calibration-transfer evaluation on frozen predictions and independent groups. ECE is estimator- and binning-dependent; bootstrap intervals are descriptive. This report does not fit a calibrator, authorize a probability threshold, prove OOD calibration, or grant release qualification.

confirmatory_threshold_transfer.claim_boundary: Applies one development-selected threshold to disjoint CONFIRMATORY_EVALUATION groups. It does not retune the threshold on target data and does not establish OOD guarantees or release qualification.

external_threshold_transfer.claim_boundary: Applies one development-selected threshold to disjoint EXTERNAL_VALIDATION groups. It does not retune the threshold on target data and does not establish OOD guarantees or release qualification.
